from lumina_compiler import LuminaAgent

class XorGateAgent(LuminaAgent):
    def configure(self):
        self.inputs = {"x": "Basin_A", "y": "Basin_B"}
        self.outputs = {"z": "Basin_SUM"}
        self.internal = {"zero": "Zero_Basin", "one": "One_Basin", "test_mass": "Test_Mass_Basin"}

    def flow(self):
        self.z = self.x ^ self.y
        # Verify all input combinations
        self.settle(10)

        # Initialize test_mass basin
        self.nudge("Test_Mass_Basin", 0.0)

        # Test Case 1: x = 0, y = 0
        self.x = self.zero
        self.y = self.zero
        self.settle(10)
        self.assert_mass("Basin_SUM", self.test_mass)

        # Test Case 2: x = 1, y = 0
        self.x = self.one
        self.y = self.zero
        self.settle(10)
        self.nudge("Test_Mass_Basin", 1.0)
        self.assert_mass("Basin_SUM", self.test_mass)

        # Test Case 3: x = 0, y = 1
        self.x = self.zero
        self.y = self.one
        self.settle(10)
        self.assert_mass("Basin_SUM", self.test_mass)

        # Test Case 4: x = 1, y = 1
        self.x = self.one
        self.y = self.one
        self.settle(10)
        self.nudge("Test_Mass_Basin", -1.0)
        self.assert_mass("Basin_SUM", self.test_mass)
